about_short_description.short_description: Taiga brings together data, artificial intelligence, integrated platforms, analytics, and strategic positioning.

product.name: Front Office Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates and analyzes real-time sales and transaction data for convenience store retailers to provide actionable insights across operations.

product.name: Aggregated Executive Dashboards
product.description: Customizable dashboards that provide real-time, consolidated views of store and enterprise performance for convenience retailers.

product.name: Real Time Operations Alerts
product.description: Automated alerts that notify convenience store operators of operational issues and anomalies as they occur in real time.

product.name: Category Management
product.description: A tool to analyze product categories and performance across stores to optimize assortment and maximize profit per shelf space.

product.name: Market Basket Analysis
product.description: An AI-driven analysis of customer purchasing habits to identify cross-promotion opportunities and increase basket profitability.

product.name: Customer Traffic Analysis
product.description: A real-time monitoring tool that tracks customer traffic to optimize staffing and operational efficiency in convenience stores.
